source:
@@U04648@@
(Strewing roses.)

@@U04649@@
Roses, you glowing ones,
Balsam-bestowing ones,
Fluttering, quivering,
Sweetness delivering,
Blossom half-opening,
Branching unblightedly,
Budding delightedly,
Scatter around you Spring,
Purple and green.
Take him to Paradise,
This sleeper serene!

@@U04651@@
(To the SATANS.)

@@U04652@@
What’s all this?
This dodging and ducking?
Is that what they taught you in Hell?
Stand fast,
let them strew till they're blue in the face!
To your posts, you idiots!
They're trying to snow-in flaming-hot devils
with their fluttery flurry of flowers,
but you have only to breathe
and it melts and shrivels!
Blow now, you blowhards!
Puffers and snorters, blow!
Stop! Enough! Enough!
Your foul breath is blighting the whole swarm!
Not so hard!
Muzzle your mouths, harness your noses!
You've overblown those roses.
Show moderation!
They've not just wilted,
they've browned, they’ve dried,
they're burning!
Pelting us now, they are,
with shining, poisonous flames!
translation:
@@U04648@@
（撒上玫瑰花。）

@@U04649@@
玫瑰，你们这些发光的，
赐香脂的人，
颤抖、颤抖、
甜蜜传递，
花开半开，
枝条无恙，
欣喜地发芽，
春天散落在你身边，
紫色和绿色。
带他去天堂，
这卧铺安详！

@@U04651@@
（对撒旦来说。）

@@U04652@@
这一切是什么？
这躲闪？
这就是他们在地狱里教你的吗？
站稳，
让它们撒得满脸青紫！
去你的帖子吧，你们这些白痴！
他们正试图用雪把炽热的魔鬼淹没
伴随着它们飞舞的花朵，
但你只需要呼吸
它会融化并枯萎！
吹吧，你们这些吹牛的人！
吹气者和鼻喷者，吹！
停止！足够的！足够的！
你的恶臭呼吸正在毁掉整个虫群！
没那么难！
堵住你的嘴，管住你的鼻子！
你把那些玫瑰花吹得太过了。
表现出节制！
它们不仅枯萎了，
它们已经变成褐色，已经干了，
他们在燃烧！
现在他们正在向我们猛击，
带着闪亮的毒焰！
